Senior Data Engineer

Minimum Qualifications
- 5+ years of experience in data engineering
- Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
- Experience with Spark and Airflow
- Must have experience designing ETL pipelines

Nice to Have
- Experience with Kafka
- Familiarity with Terraform
- Preferred: background in the healthcare industry

What You'll Do
- Design and maintain large-scale data pipelines
- Partner with analytics and product teams
- Mentor junior data engineers
